title: AdaPRA: Process Reward Agents with Adaptive Rubrics for Data Science
abstract: arXiv:2610.33245v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data science agents can automate end-to-end machine learning workflows, yet they remain far from competitive on human leaderboards. Agents make process errors such as insufficient exploration, unsound validation, coding bugs, and poor use of a fixed budget (re-running the same exploratory data analysis and baseline models in every attempt). We propose AdaPRA to address these issues: a persistent coding agent harness that accumulates knowledge across attempts on the same task, with rubric-guided process supervision that identifies and corrects errors. Our process reward agent audits the agent's trajectory and workspace by executing checks, and adapts its rubrics to each task. We find that rubrics seeded from easier tasks generalize to harder tasks, with rubric adaptation further improving performance. translated_title: AdaPRA：面向数据科学的自适应评分标准过程奖励智能体
translated_abstract: 数据科学智能体可以实现端到端机器学习工作流的自动化，但它们在人类排行榜上的竞争力仍相去甚远。智能体会犯各种过程性错误，例如探索不足、验证不可靠、编码缺陷以及固定预算使用不当（在每次尝试中都重复运行相同的探索性数据分析和基线模型）。我们提出 AdaPRA 来解决这些问题：一个持久化编码智能体框架，能够在同一任务的多次尝试中积累知识，并通过评分标准引导的过程监督来识别和纠正错误。我们的过程奖励智能体通过执行检查来审计智能体的轨迹和工作空间，并针对每个任务自适应调整其评分标准。我们发现，从较简单任务中生成的评分标准可以泛化到更难的任务，而评分标准的自适应调整能进一步提升性能。每个任务进行五次尝试时，AdaPRA 将 80B 的 Qwen 模型在 DSPredict-Easy 上的排行榜百分位提高了 24.5 个百分点，在另一数据集上提高了 14.8 个百分点。
tldr: 提出AdaPRA框架，通过持久化积累任务知识并利用自适应评分标准进行过程监督，审计并纠正数据科学智能体的过程性错误，显著提升其在人类排行榜上的表现。
en_tdlr: AdaPRA is a persistent coding agent harness with adaptive rubric-guided process supervision that accumulates knowledge across attempts, audits trajectories and workspaces to correct process errors, and significantly improves data science agents' leaderboard performance.
